guide.intro: Who sees what is decided by these three simple rules.

SUPER_ADMIN.name: SuperAdmin (Platform)
SUPER_ADMIN.desc: Manages the list of companies: create, suspend, reactivate. Does not automatically see business data inside a company.

COMPANY_ADMIN.name: Admin / CEO (Company Admin)
COMPANY_ADMIN.desc: Full control within the company: create/edit/delete projects, teams and all members.

COMPANY_DELEGATE.name: Delegate
COMPANY_DELEGATE.desc: Equal to the Admin, differing only by a custom display title (e.g. Deputy CEO).

COMPANY_MEMBER.name: Company member
COMPANY_MEMBER.desc: No access until added to a specific project.

PROJECT_MEMBER.name: Project member
PROJECT_MEMBER.desc: Represents the owner; sees the whole team tree in assigned projects. Cannot create/delete structure.

TEAM_SUPERVISION.name: Supervision team (TVGS)
TEAM_SUPERVISION.desc: Sees itself and every child team (Contractor, Testing) beneath it.

TEAM_CONTRACTOR.name: Contractor team
TEAM_CONTRACTOR.desc: Works only within its own team. Cannot see other contractors or the parent Supervision.

TEAM_TESTING.name: Testing team
TEAM_TESTING.desc: Works only within its own team. Cannot see siblings or the parent.

lawA.name: Project isolation
lawA.desc: A company member only sees directly-assigned projects. Admins and Delegates see every project.

lawB.name: Team-tree isolation
lawB.desc: Each team sees only itself and its descendants — never siblings, never ancestors.

lawC.name: Structural admin rights
lawC.desc: Only Admins and Delegates may create/edit/delete projects, teams and members. Even team leads cannot.
